scope: All units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page.

items.issue: “ever the same” has no word in the page text (it belongs to another reading of the line, sadā me samatvam); the three negations were softened to “beyond”.
items.change: Now “for me there is no detachment, no liberation, nothing to be known”.

items.issue: Line 3 reads na cāsaṅgataṃ naiva muktir na meyaḥ. A widely recited form is sadā me samatvaṃ na muktir na bandhaḥ (“I am ever the same; for me neither liberation nor bondage”).
options: B. Change to the recited form and retranslate.
items.recommend: A unless your recitation text has the other.
